tasks.spec:
You are building a billed-run harness for a narration probe in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py (new) and tests/test_boarding_probe.py (new). Never edit storygame/, data/, docs/, bench/frozen/. Never make a live call: only `--dry` is run by you.

READ FIRST: .plans/1a-transcript-continuity/boarding-probe-prereg.md (the approved design; follow it exactly), scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py (copy its patterns for CallCounter, dry/live urlopen, QUOTA_CODES stop, call cap, `--confirm` plus CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL gating, output JSON), and tests/test_place_scoped_feed.py (`_state_at`, `_stub_transport`, `_turn_prompt`: how to build the product-wired provider with `build_capture_provider(state)`, stubbed network and a stubbed Jev client whose ask returns boards: true and only_boards: true).

BUILD boarding_probe.py with: 
1. Prompt builder: for each of 3 prompts (P1 'Go out to the truck.' from outside_house; P2 'Get in.' from outside_house; P3 'Go out to the truck.' from the kitchen) build, with network stubbed, the exact narrator request the current code sends (system and user text). That is arm 0 (control).
2. Arm 1: take the control user text; remove the line starting 'Just before this:' from wherever it appears; the same steps text (without the label) becomes the final PLAYER line instead of the command line (so it is the thing to narrate). Nothing else changes.
3. Arm 2: control plus ONE new line at the end of the CONSTRAINTS section: `Show every thing named in the Just before this line.` System text is identical in every arm.
4. `--dry`: write --out JSON with the three control prompts, each arm's user text, and a unified diff of each arm vs control, makes zero model calls and zero network use; print a short summary. Fail loudly (nonzero exit, message) if a control prompt has no 'Just before this:' line, since the arms depend on it.
5. `--run --samples N --confirm`: send each (arm, prompt) N times, interleaved round-robin (arm-major within each sample index), one narrator call each through the same transport the provider uses (cloudflare.urlopen-style request to CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL, same body shape as the provider's narrator request), no Jev or item-facts calls, no retries, no replacements; record raw reply text and the narration parsed from it (segments text joined; mark unparseable as unusable) per row; write partial rows after every call; hard cap --max-calls default 100 (refuse to start if arms x prompts x samples exceeds it); stop immediately on a 429 whose body has AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED and record the stop reason. Live needs --confirm and CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL, else exit nonzero without any call. Add a `--dry-run-calls` style offline mode only if live_baseline has one; otherwise tests inject a fake opener.
6. Do not score; scoring is by hand.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_boarding_probe.py (hermetic, no network, no live worker): arm text transforms on a synthetic prompt string (arm 1 removes the label line and moves the steps to the last PLAYER line; arm 2 adds exactly one constraints line; arms 0 and system text unchanged); the dry run on the real 1A package writes 3 prompts x 3 arms with the diff and makes zero opener calls; missing 'Just before this:' fails loudly; the cap refuses 3x3x12; the run with a fake opener makes exactly arms x prompts x samples calls in interleaved order, writes partial rows, and stops on a quota 429; live without --confirm makes no call.

FINISH: ruff format and ruff check both files; run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_boarding_probe.py`; run the `--dry` on the real package to /tmp/boarding-probe-dry.json and print the three control prompts' lengths and the arm 1 and arm 2 diffs for prompt P1. Report anything in the prereg you could not follow.
